name: Follow Amber help
description: Help mode entries for the Follow Amber plugin (help@1): its settings tab and the approval pop-up.
author: Brett

entries.title: Follow Amber settings
entries.text: One switch for all your consoles. On: whenever Amber mentions a screen, settings tab, dialog or anything that needs you, the console opens it and highlights it, and axHub approvals pop up here with one-tap Approve and Deny. Off: nothing opens by itself and approvals stay in the approvals banner.

entries.title: Approval waiting
entries.text: A call axHub holds for you. Veto calls show the countdown: Deny stops it, Approve runs it now. Calls that need your approval run only if you approve. The exact call is folded under the description. Several waiting: they queue, held calls first. Where the console can't sign the decision for you, axHub's own page opens inside the pop-up for the tap.

entries.title: waiting: show them
entries.text: Opens the approvals waiting for you, one at a time, oldest first.

entries.title: Show the banner chip while following
entries.text: On: a small Following Amber chip sits in the banner while Follow Amber is on; tap it to turn Follow Amber off.

entries.title: Flash it
entries.text: When Amber opens something for you, the item she means (the row, card, button or text she named, or the screen or dialog itself) flashes its background so you spot it. Off: it still opens and scrolls into view.

entries.title: First colour
entries.text: The first flash colour (yellow by default). Left at the default, the colour theme's flash colour is used.

entries.title: Second colour
entries.text: The second flash colour (orange by default); the flashes alternate between the two.

entries.title: Flashes
entries.text: How many times it flashes (1 to 10, 5 by default).

entries.title: Speed
entries.text: How fast it flashes. Normal: five flashes take 2.5 seconds. With reduced motion on, it pulses an outline once instead.

entries.title: Follow Amber on / off
entries.text: Turns Follow Amber on or off. On: what Amber talks about opens in this console and approvals pop up here.

entries.title: Waiting approvals
entries.text: Opens the approvals waiting for you.
